hook: Every village now gets *one plan* with monthly check-ups.
hook_b: Every village now gets *one plan* with monthly check-ups.
tldr: Telangana launched GPSAP 2026, a unified village development plan that merges schemes and adds monthly monitoring.

beats.what: The Hindu: GPSAP 2026 integrates schemes, monthly monitoring, SDG alignment and household data into one village plan.
beats.why: One plan per village replaces separate scheme lists.
beats.care: If your family lives in a village, you can ask for the plan and its monthly review.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Per The Hindu's summary, the plan covers scheme integration, monthly monitoring, SDG alignment and household data.

cards.q: One village plan with monthly checks. What would make it work?

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Telangana introduces unified village development planning framework

insight: It merges schemes with household data and SDG goals.
